name: Executor Script
original_name: エグゼクタースクリプト
source:
In a world where some people possess magic-like special abilities, Hayato is a student who can use a power called ‘executor’. Together with his friend Shin they cause a commotion and one day, they were defeated by a girl named Primity Lumina, sent by the international organization Aproca to protect against ill-use of abilities. A few days later, Shin starts to use his powers to destroy the town to conquer the world. Primity Lumina approaches Hayato to request his help in defeating Shin, while Shin also wanted him to join his side. Which he give in to the dark side or fight for justice alongside a cute bishoujo?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在一个部分人拥有魔法般特殊能力的世界，隼人是一名能够使用“executor”之力的学生。他与朋友慎一起惹出骚乱，某天却败给了一名叫Primity Lumina的少女。她受国际组织Aproca派遣，负责防止能力遭到滥用。几天后，慎开始用力量摧毁城镇，企图征服世界。Primity Lumina找到隼人，请求他协助打败慎；与此同时，慎也希望隼人加入自己一方。他会屈服于黑暗，还是与可爱的美少女并肩为正义而战？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/07/01/july-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
